subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Florence Nightingale was born in Florance in Italy. She was a devoted Christian. She was determined to sacrifice herself in nursing sick people. She was given her first post reorganizing a small hospital in London. She went on a mission to serve soldiers wounded fighting the Russions. She went to Turkey with 38 nurses to serve the wounder soldiers in the war. She served there a number soldiers who were dying of diseases. She inquired every corner of the hospitals and served the soldiers. Thus she became a heroine to the British soldiers.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See United Islamia Govt. High School, Madaripur. Sl. No. 137; Page No. 179
